evidence.quote: It's obviously a disk permission problem. The default session used the disk files. You can change to database session.  [reporter: "Okay, I'll redeploy it and take a look."]

notes: Filesystem permissions on the Docker data volume (/data/gitea/sessions) break the file session provider; fix is deployment (permissions or app.ini session provider). Medium: reporter did not explicitly confirm the fix.
